gate_scope.note: The deterministic gate suite runs WIDE over the whole engine, including compiler and linker; their gate output on hardened code is itself informative. The finder arms (R, C, P) see only region_paths.

measured_note: LOC and file counts measured at target_commit with find over *.ts/*.tsx, excluding *.test.*/*.spec.* and /test/ and __tests__ dirs. No source files sit loose at the src/engine root; all target source is under the nine region_paths.
